DILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA corner Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http: //www.dilg.com.ph DILG OPINION No. 88 s. 2022 SEP 09 2022 MR. MARK MICHAEL O. UNLU-CAY Ex-Officio SP Member/President Panlungsod na Pederasyon ng Sangguniang Kabataan, City of Baybay, Province of Leyte Dear Mr. Unlu-cay: This refers to your letter dated August 01, 2022, addressed to DILG Secretary, Atty. Benjamin C. Abalos, Jr., seeking assistance relative to the conduct of the Sangguniang Kabataan (SK) Special Elections not only in the City of Baybay but across the country. In this connection, please be informed that the Department issued Memorandum Circular Nos. 2018-212 and 2019-04 dated December 20, 2018 and January 16, 2019, to assist and guide the SK Chairpersons in the performance of their mandate to call for a Katipunan ng Kabataan Assembly to elect an SK member to complete the membership of said sanggunian, pursuant to Section 19(b) of the SK Reform Act of 2015. However the Commission on Elections (COMELEC) issued an opinion stating that the conduct of SK Special Elections is within the mandate of the Commission. Further, COMELEC Law Department, in its Memorandum to the Commission En Banc, dated January 08, 2019, stated in part that: 'DILG Circular No. 2018-212 dated December 20, 2018 constitutes as an encroachment to the constitutional power of the Commission to administer all laws and requlations relative to the conduct of the election, plebiscite, initiative, referendum, and recall.' (Underscoring for emphasis) For its part, DILG issued Legal Opinion No. 09, S. 2020 dated January 07, 2020, submitting that it is COMELEC that is the proper government agency that shall conduct the SK Special Elections. Thus, queries relative to the SKSE shall not be answered anymore by the Department. "Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

With the foregoing, clearly, this Department is bereft of power and authority to issue related policies that address the vacancy problem in the SK for reasons stated in the above discussions. Nonetheless, rest assured that we will continue to follow-up and again urge the Commission to act on this matter. Thank you. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: GAN MARL Undersec tary for Local Government Page 2 of 2
